prompt: A patient is taking oral morphine 90 mg per day for chronic pain and needs to be switched to oral hydromorphone. Using an oral morphine to oral hydromorphone equianalgesic ratio of 5:1, what is the equivalent total daily oral hydromorphone dose?

rubric_items.text: States the equianalgesic total daily oral hydromorphone dose is 18 mg/day (90 mg ÷ 5; exact match required).
